biotools.summary: An annotation framework designed to distill expert medical knowledge for tagging Polish medical texts. It utilizes multilingual LLMs (like Llama3.1) to annotate large corpora, which are then used to train and evaluate specialized classifiers (DistilBERT, BioBERT, HerBERT).
